_comment: Hand-entered targets that no fetched source can supply. An entry belongs
here ONLY when the object is a real, commonly imaged target AND no
machine-readable catalog in config.mjs carries it — the Propeller sits in
the DWB catalog (Dickel, Wendker & Bieritz 1969), which SIMBAD indexes as
identifiers but VizieR does not publish as a table, so there is nothing to
pin a sha256 to. Prefer adding a real source over adding a row here.
Every field is curated, so every entry MUST carry `provenance` naming where
each value came from, and parsers/extras.mjs fails loud if it is missing.
`size_arcmin` may be null when no catalog dimension exists and no defensible
estimate is available; the geometry fields degrade the same way they do for
These bake to catalog-extras.json as a SEPARATE file — they are the least
authoritative rows in the repo and consumers should be able to tell.

provenance.position: SIMBAD basic for ident 'DWB 111' (main_id DWB 111, otype HII). Low precision — the value is exactly 20h16m00s +43°40′00″ with no coo_bibcode, inherited from the 1969 DWB survey. Good to roughly an arcminute, no better.
provenance.size_arcmin: APPROXIMATE. Neither SIMBAD nor any pinned source carries a dimension for this object; 20′ is the long-axis extent the object presents in amateur narrowband imaging. Treat as a planning figure, not a measurement.
provenance.designations: 'DWB 111' is the only catalogue identifier SIMBAD lists. 'Simeis 57' and 'Propeller Nebula' are in universal amateur use but are NOT SIMBAD identifiers — they exist only here, which is the entire reason this entry does.
